what: The declared alternate reference corpora: the widened band measurement's six (file, language) cells re-scored with the mapped set, streams, seeds, machinery, restarts, sweep cap, plants, floors, block-fold split and band population carried forward unchanged and every scored table rebuilt from single declared alternate references outside the band (english pg76 Twain, latin pg60772 Fabri volumen secundum), so the real is priced against the same band under a reference scope no longer the standing references' single choice. The bridge gate re-derived the frozen widened-band artifact's first cell through the standing reference before the alternate cells ran. The declared truthful question: does the real's held-out score-half value still stand above the band when the scored tables are rebuilt from the alternate references. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading.

declared.split_rule: the counted pairs of each side, in stream order, split into contiguous blocks at the midpoint: the first floor(N/2) pairs the climb half the machinery may search, the remaining pairs the score half it may never touch; for an odd count the climb half takes the smaller first block; the halves share no counted pair and every identity anchor's halves fold by the same rule; deterministic, consuming no seed
declared.loo_rule: the shape measurement's leave-one-out form carried exactly onto the declared alternate reference's counts: the inherited add-one backing form is log((n_ab + 1) / (N + 729)) with N the declared alternate reference stream's total counted pairs; every pair type (a, b) present in the alternate reference pair table is scored with one occurrence of (a, b) removed from the alternate reference counts, log(n_ab / (N + 728)), and a type with no counted occurrence keeps the inherited add-one entry log(1 / (N + 729)); the letter marginals are the alternate reference's unigram counts and the rank initialisation mechanics unchanged, the matrix arithmetic needing no re-derivation as the shape measurement declared
declared.measured_facts_rule: the mapped set, streams, seeds, machinery, restarts, sweep cap, floors, split and band population are the held-out screen's, block-fold measurement's and widened band's declarations carried unchanged; the real, the floors and every band member's encodings are byte-identical replays of the frozen artifacts' declared draws, and each cell's five plants are encodings of the declared alternate reference text truncated to the same declared length, from the declared plant kinds at the declared positions; only the scored tables change: every machinery call prices its matrices under the declared alternate reference's leave-one-out table with the alternate's letter marginals for the rank initialisation; each side's exact full-data side call is recorded beside its held-out value for attribution only
declared.machinery_rule: unchanged from the held-out screen: the exact greedy reassignment climb on the climb half, exact pricing on the score half, restart 0 the rank initialisation from the climb half, restarts 1 onward the seeded permutations of the 27 letter tokens under the wrap rule, the best restart the best exact climb-half total with ties to the first; no assignment is stored
declared.seed_sharing: no new seed kinds are consumed: the real, floors and band members replay the declared draws from the declared kinds at the declared positions exactly as the frozen artifacts consumed them; each cell's plants consume the declared plant kinds 24 and 25 at positions 0 to 4 against the alternate reference text, the same kind and position consumption the frozen artifacts declared for their plants of the standing reference text; the band members consume the declared cross kinds at positions english 0 to 6 and latin 0 to 7 exactly as the frozen widened band consumed them; consuming none of any other module's declared draws
declared.bridge_gate: before the alternate cells run, the alternate instrument's full first cell (ZL english: the real, its five plants of the standing reference text, its five floors and its seven widened band members) is computed through this measurement's code with the standing reference supplied and compared field for field against the frozen widened-band artifact's own first cell; any divergence aborts with nothing written
declared.corpus_source_rule: the alternate references are fetched from the standing members' declared source in the same plain text form; each alternate's file is stored raw under engine/data with its Gutenberg markers and processed by the standing declared processing (the body extracted between the markers, the ligatures joined, NFD plus casefold, letters to 0 to 25 and non-letter runs to the single boundary token), with the sha256 recorded below
declared.corpus_rule: alternate references are declared per language, one each, under the declared corpus rules: the english alternate a modern printed english prose text outside the band's membership list; the latin alternate a latin prose text outside the band's membership list keeping the standing members' transcriber-note english scaffold scale (0 to 52 common-word hits, zero mid-span english in every accepted member); candidates interleaving english translations, glossed school notes, critical apparatus or scholarly bibliographies through the span, or whose form is other than connected prose, rejected with cause
declared.same_work_family_rule: the declared latin alternate pg60772 is volume two of the same printed travel account whose volume one is widened band member pg58528: the circumstance is disclosed and the design keeps the declared single alternate rather than swapping to another candidate, because the remaining probed candidates were rejected with cause or terse in form; the reference scope stays a single alternate choice outside the band membership list

declared.band_record_rule: membership, selection, ties and spreads are declared unchanged from the held-out screen (a member's band value the held-out value of the draw whose exact climb-half total is best, strict beyond 1e-12, ties to the first draw); each member records draws_climb_exact, its five climb-half totals at full precision, so the declared selection is re-derivable from the stored artifact; membership unconditional: every band member enters the band under the alternate tables exactly as under the standing tables and no convergence criterion is applied to any member
declared.verdict_rule: unchanged from the held-out screen and applied to the reference-scope numbers: the real held-out at or above the smallest member band value is consistent-with-substitution, at or below the largest floor's held-out value is not-consistent, strictly between is below-held-band; the strings describe consistency under this artifact's declared reference scope and do not restate the widened band's verdicts
declared.margin_rule: the margin is computed from the stored rounded values: the real held-out mean minus the smallest member band value, rounded to four decimals
declared.exclusion_rule: the family's declared exclusion format is not re-scoped by this artifact: it keys to the declared 36-slot class under the inherited add-one form exactly as the held-out screen declared it, so an alternate-reference verdict is reference-scope evidence and the widened band's verdicts stand untouched by this artifact's numbers
declared.truthful_question: declared in advance: does the real's held-out score-half value still stand above the band when the scored tables are rebuilt from single alternate references outside the band - a yes extends the separation across the reference scope, a no records that the margin rode the standing references' single choice
